name: boot_copy_and_poll_raster
description: Boot block entry that copies a block of code and a short table into low memory, patches one copied longword, and polls a video position register before writing custom-chip setup registers and storing a four-character tag. The listing is cut short by calls to unnamed routines.

name: enable_dma_after_raster_wait
description: Patches a longword at the argument pointer, waits for a video position, writes custom-chip sprite and DMA registers, then sets the DMA control and interrupt enable registers. It returns the second parameter, and a different stack value short-circuits to a fixed return.

name: boot_program_custom_chip_state
description: Boot block routine that calls a library function at a fixed offset and writes the colour, DMA control, interrupt enable and interrupt request registers along with one more custom-chip register. The decompiler timed out, so the sequence of writes is only partly visible from the facts.

name: copy_longs_and_set_colour
description: Copies a long run of longwords from a source address to low memory, then writes a fixed value to a colour register and patches a byte in the copied area.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: The decompiled listing is a single undecodable-bytes marker for 185 instructions, so no behaviour is recovered from this entry.

name: wait_raster_and_setup_registers
description: Waits for a video position, then writes custom-chip registers and calls a series of nine routines in a loop until a busy bit clears.

name: shift_table_entries
description: Decrements a counter in a global; when it reaches zero it resets the counter to three and shifts seven word entries of a table forward by one, storing the saved first word in the last slot.

name: write_pair_then_call_loop
description: Calls a routine, writes the same constant value to two offsets of a structure, then calls another routine 24 times in a loop.

name: advance_countdown_timer_entry
description: Writes two constant values into a structure, then decrements a countdown word. When it reaches zero it reloads it to four and either sets a flag or calls a routine with a buffer address while advancing a position global.

name: copy_longs_to_fixed_block
description: Copies sixteen longwords from a global area to a fixed low-memory address and then sets a global to that address.

name: step_frame_state_counter
description: Decrements a small state counter held in globals and, when it reloads, steps a state word through a fixed sequence with wrap-around. It selects one of two fixed buffer addresses depending on the state.

name: store_two_buffer_pointers
description: Stores two buffer addresses and two counts into four global words and returns.

name: pack_input_bits_value
description: Combines flag bits taken from two input words and a shifted coordinate into a packed 32-bit value, and returns a 16-bit result derived from one input.

name: store_struct_from_registers
description: Calls a routine, then writes shifted short values from registers and two longs from the stack into fields of a structure, duplicating one long into another field.

name: reset_object_state
description: Calls a routine, clears a block of memory pointed to by a global, then stores fixed values into fields of a structure and copies a pointer into another field.

name: wait_blitter_idle
description: Spins until the blitter busy flag in the DMA status register clears.

name: clear_table_and_copy_block
description: Calls a routine and clears two words in each of 24 sixteen-byte table entries, then copies sixteen longwords from a global area to a fixed low-memory address.

name: update_entries_by_division
description: Iterates over 24 entries of 16-bit records, decrements a per-entry counter, and recomputes each record's position by division until the result lies within fixed bounds.

name: update_seed_and_modulo
description: Advances a 16-bit state held in a global by a multiply, an add and a reduction, looping until no carry remains, then returns the new state modulo the input argument.

name: scale_and_store_word_pair
description: Calls a routine twice; stores the first result, offset by 176 and shifted left by eight, into a word, then stores the second result shifted left by eight into the next word, followed by a constant word.

name: initialize_display_list
description: When a global counter is zero, copies pairs of words from a table into a buffer and recurses to fill it; it then writes fields of a structure, including a word derived from the counter, and calls another routine.

name: find_next_nonzero_entry
description: Scans a byte table from a rotating global index for the next non-zero entry, decodes it by XOR and tests whether it lies in a fixed range; in-range values trigger a block copy of table entries.

name: initialize_global_table
description: Writes a series of fixed addresses into global variables, clears fifteen entries of a global table to zero, and copies one global pointer into another.

name: clear_audio_volume_state
description: Writes zero to six shared globals and fifteen to one more. The facts show the audio volume and DMA control registers touched, reached here through the same shared global names.

name: tick_audio_step_counter
description: Returns at once when a global counter is zero; otherwise it increments the counter and, on reaching six, resets it, calls four routines, runs a short delay loop and adjusts a global.

name: program_audio_channel_registers
description: Decodes a packed control byte for a sound sample and programs the location and length registers of the four audio channels, enabling their DMA through the DMA control register.

name: update_nibble_indexed_record
description: Reads a byte from a source record, uses its high nibble to index a table, and copies table values into fields of a destination record. When the destination is non-zero it also copies further fields and ORs a flag into a global.

name: report_unrecovered_routine
description: The decompiler timed out on this 118-instruction routine, so its behaviour is not recovered from the listing. The facts show it was never executed in the reference run and has no recovered calls.

name: boot_issue_io_and_run
description: Boot block entry that fills an I/O request with a transfer length and offset, calls a library function, then calls the code loaded at a fixed address.

name: stub_return_only
description: Two-instruction routine whose decompiled listing is empty; no calls, memory access or register use is visible, so no behaviour is recovered.

name: dispatch_interrupt_request_bits
description: Checks a flag in a global, then tests the interrupt request bits in order and calls a handler for each set bit, reading the interrupt request registers. A clear flag skips the dispatch.
